hook.text: Google has 90% of search. The second-place engine has less than 5%. In some markets, the winner takes almost everything.

buildup.text: Winner-take-all markets emerge when small advantages compound.

twist.text: Being second in a winner-take-all market is nearly worthless. The return difference between first and second is not 10%.

climax.text: Determine if your field is winner-take-all. If yes, focus aggressively on being first.

punchline.text: In some arenas, second place wins nothing.

quiz.question: Who described winner-take-all economics in academic research?
